title: APM tracing is failing due to span being ended twice
body:
### Elasticsearch Version

8.11

### Installed Plugins

_No response_

### Java Version

_bundled_

### OS Version

mac

### Problem Description

### Steps to Reproduce

start ES with tracing enabled

```
cat ../apm_enable_statefull.gradle 
rootProject {
  if (project.name == 'elasticsearch') {
    afterEvaluate {
      testClusters.matching { it.name == "runTask" }.configureEach {
        setting 'xpack.security.audit.enabled', 'true'
        keystore 'tracing.apm.secret_token', 'YOURPASSWORD'
        setting 'telemetry.metrics.enabled', 'true'
        setting 'tracing.apm.enabled', 'true'

      setting 'tracing.apm.agent.server_url', 'YOUR server' 
      }
    }
  }
}

```


start ES
` ./gradlew run -I ../apm_enable_statefull.gradle `

post a doc

curl --request POST \
  --url http://localhost:9200/xxx2232/_doc \
  --header 'Accept: application/vnd.elasticsearch+json;compatible-with=8' \
  --header 'Authorization: Basic ZWxhc3RpYy1hZG1pbjplbGFzdGljLXBhc3N3b3Jk' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/vnd.elasticsearch+json;compatible-with=8' \
  --data '{
	"x":123
}'



call a search api
curl --request GET \
  --url http://localhost:9200/xxx2232/_search \
  --header 'Accept: application/vnd.elasticsearch+json;compatible-with=8' \
  --header 'Authorization: Basic ZWxhc3RpYzpwYXNzd29yZA==' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/vnd.elasticsearch+json;compatible-with=8'
